title: A short visit
caption: Zoe: The cold sand, and a shorter day. I am still out here like the dune owes me July. Alex: The warm sun owes you a short visit. Twenty or thirty minutes outside even with clouds. In winter, nobody gets a fixed fifteen minutes.

title: Twenty easy minutes
